description: List records of one type — Contacts, Organisations, Leads, Opportunities, Projects, Tasks, Events or Notes — optionally filtered by one field value and/or last-updated time. With field_name + field_value (both required together) or updated_after_utc this uses GET /<Object>/Search; otherwise GET /<Object>. Field names are Insightly's UPPER_SNAKE names, e.g. EMAIL_ADDRESS, LAST_NAME, ORGANISATION_NAME, OPPORTUNITY_STATE, LEAD_RATING, or a custom field such as Industry__c.

brief.description: true = only top-level fields (no CUSTOMFIELDS, TAGS, LINKS, ...). Smaller and faster.

count_total.description: true = also return the total number of matching records (response becomes {total_count, items}).

field_name.description: Field to filter on, e.g. EMAIL_ADDRESS.

updated_after_utc.description: Only records updated after this time, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ (e.g. 2026-04-09T16:58:14Z).

name: insightly_list_records
title: List or search records
